qualification: READ_ONLY_SOURCE_REVIEW; proposal only; no current-task UI, HTTP, provider or browser acceptance

outcome.partner_input: Separate launcher reads hidden interactive TTY; explicit ephemeral child environment YCLIENTS_PARTNER_TOKEN before AppModule/adapter initialization; no argv, ambient credential inheritance, file or browser submission.
outcome.user_input: Existing password input after ordinary signup/password login; selected tenant-owned branch and company ID; existing encrypted local server persistence only after separate explicit staging consent.
outcome.interpretation: Provider GET-only is compatible with separately admitted explicit A17 local activation/import. It is not a claim that local state remains read-only.

current_ui.fact: Loopback plus local_crm_setup=1 controls presentation only; normal sign-in precedes setup. No chat or widgets.runtime grant is needed by the direct setup path. Standard subscription and tenant/actor guards still apply.
No automatic setup load/preview/discover on mount. Explicit load reads connection, branch list and existing operation locator. Stage and activate are separate buttons with separate consent.

Token value exists in password-input DOM ref and transient submission closure, not React state/storage; cleared synchronously before stage/activate, on load/close/signout/unmount. UI keeps only hasToken boolean.

Copy correctly states encrypted storage on the connected MAYA server and partner token configured separately; it does not prove that the server database is isolated. Launcher evidence must provide that guarantee.
Activation UI trusts finite port eligibility and displayed configuration version, preserves operation receipt/current-version distinction, and never equates import_confirmed with bookability.
UNKNOWN does not silently retry. Explicit authoritative receipt recovery and same operation UUID are used; NOT_OBSERVED permits owner reentry without claiming old plaintext request restoration.

Current activation wording authorizes import generally; the exact local effects below should be disclosed in the separate profile landing/handoff before enabling it. No copy edit was made in this task.

direct_api.writes: Existing qualified connect/activate only; Idempotency-Key and expectedVersion; no generic provider proxy or extra credential endpoint.
direct_api.authority: A17 rechecks active user + tenant membership. OWNER_ROLES currently includes tenant_owner, business_owner, tenant_admin, administrator; presentation is not authorization. An owner-only pilot admission can further narrow this without broadening canonical roles.

provider_read_inventory.explanation: Native preview checks accessible company directory, then selected-company services/categories/staff/team/profile. Existing finite endpoint fallbacks and A17 source revalidation can repeat reads; no one-GET claim. Staff and team share one adapter catalog promise per preview.

local_effect_inventory.effect: Provider GET preview before admission, then encrypted user credential + fingerprint/provider/company/branch binding into crmIntegration pending_activation; error/verification fields reset; existing AE command/attempt/outcome/receipt and controller audit. No staff/client/appointment import.

Fresh provider GET verification; local crmIntegration active and verification timestamps; tenant.calendarSource external; non-mock brandingSettings.themeJson.booking.mode live. This local flag is not permission for provider writes and not proof of booking availability.

Second canonical command uses fresh accepted provider snapshot; updates acceptedImportSnapshotHash and sync timestamps; projects staff/access/presentation inside the same transaction as import receipt, atomicProjection true.

Creates local Staff with encrypted display name, StaffProviderLink, CrmStaffAccess pending_contact; updates titles and links. Existing non-owner access can become active/pending_contact/disabled; absent members can be suspended and sessions revoked. Does not create new User accounts in this projection.

Valid company timezone may update tenant default and all branches following previous default/null, not merely the selected branch. Safe HTTPS company logo URL can update branding, respecting uploaded logo priority. URL is stored, not downloaded by this import.

This import path does not import clients or appointments/records and does not materialize the complete service catalog in local Service rows. Services participate in preview/source evidence. No provider POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE occurs in this source call tree.

Activation and import are sequential canonical commands, not one transaction together: activation may succeed while import remains unconfirmed. Preserve qualified receipt phase and current-version relation.

concrete_limits.limit: Current ordinary native GET request allows default redirect following.
concrete_limits.required_before_admission: Separate real-profile outbound boundary must force redirect:error and pin exact HTTPS origin/method/path/query; reject unexpected source/host and provider non-GET. Shared adapter/synthetic profile need not be broadened.

concrete_limits.limit: Preview truncates services/staff to 30 and team to 50. Existing import evidence checks team.items, not original team.count; reconcile treats absent existing staff as inactive.
concrete_limits.qualification: Do not claim complete catalog/team import. For safe bounded real pilot, refuse incomplete/over-50 team source before activation or get explicit narrow admission based on a verified complete fresh-tenant source; current code has no such new profile guard.

concrete_limits.limit: The native permission check reads the accessible companies directory.
concrete_limits.qualification: Disclose that directory GET and do not claim every allowed request URI is scoped to the selected company. Never archive returned real company/staff names or raw responses.

concrete_limits.limit: Qualified connect returns current configuration/receipt, not the preview rows.
concrete_limits.qualification: Do not promise services/staff counts will always be visible after stage; stagedCounts can be absent.

concrete_limits.limit: Partner token is captured in adapter constructor and adapters may be cached.
concrete_limits.qualification: Supply once before AppModule starts; restart and private prompt for replacement. Do not implement mid-flight global env swaps.

proposed_implementation_scope.existing_ui_net_changes: None required for token separation or existing qualified A17 actions; no new transport, secret store, public partner-token endpoint or widgets grant.
proposed_implementation_scope.separation: Keep stage0 launcher/profile/runtime environment allowlist, providerAdmission:false, refusal routes and synthetic behavior unchanged.
proposed_implementation_scope.tty_contract: Interactive TTY required; hidden no-echo bounded input; restore terminal on success/cancel/error; reject non-TTY. Do not inherit provider secret from process environment, save it, include in arguments, logs, reports, IPC or service-keys.json. Only explicit owned runtime child environment receives it. Do not pass it to PG/migrations/frontend or descendants.
proposed_implementation_scope.admission: Dedicated fixed profile name and explicit real-read admission, independently optional activation/import admission; finite expiry, exact owned local DB evidence, source binding, current ordinary authenticated owner and selected company/tenant/branch. Profile flag does not replace canonical backend checks.
proposed_implementation_scope.ingress: Exact normal onboarding/auth/status/branches/operation paths plus qualified connect; activate only when separately admitted. Preserve Host/Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site guard at browser relay and backend. Keep clients/records/booking/goods/model/chat/widget/effect/background routes refused.
proposed_implementation_scope.egress: Native fetch passthrough only for admitted GET inventory; fixed YCLIENTS base URL, no ambient overrides, no redirects, finite time/response/request budgets, generic sanitized denial. No injected provider response or token/session mocks.
proposed_implementation_scope.background: All scheduler flags remain disabled, no startup provider read, no automatic activation/import/retry, no background C10 work.
proposed_implementation_scope.secret_storage_note: User token persists encrypted in the existing local server DB together with existing retained encryption keys. Partner token is process-only, not durable. JS/process memory cannot promise forensic zeroization; stop owned process and avoid crash dumps/environment logging.

remaining_before_real_use: Parent decision and implementation of separate profile admission/TTY/outbound guards.
Focused source-bound guard tests and actual current React/local profile qualification; none claimed by this review.
Exact local effect disclosure before explicit activation, including staff access/session and timezone effects; preserve failed/partial receipt states.
Owner privately supplies partner/user tokens through the approved private paths; never send them in chat.
